name: 4m
source:
Our guy's high school friend asked him to help his sister. It seems that she lost all emotions after a car accident that killed her parents. He need to help her get back her happiness, anger, sadness and love. Can he do it?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
主角的高中朋友请他帮助自己的妹妹。似乎在一场夺走父母性命的车祸后，她失去了所有情感。他需要帮助她找回快乐、愤怒、悲伤和爱。他能做到吗？

[来自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050209185814/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wna.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
